_comment: Source entries the Scrape.Tests.ps1 tests read by name. Test data only: these are not running sources.

sources.name: bluebird-social
sources.notes: Test data. Outdoor music venue and bar. Modern Events Calendar, so times need localTimeAsUtc. Most listings are food trucks and open or closed days: those are skipped by title, or because the description is only shortcodes or 'BACK TO FOOD TRUCK CALENDAR'. That leaves the concerts, Pray for Snow, and CU watch parties. Watch parties with no time yet are listed at noon. Category defaults to nightlife-social, because watch party titles such as 'Oregon State @ CU' match no sports keyword

sources.name: boulder-county-fairgrounds
sources.notes: Test data. Public events only. The page also lists conventions, meetings, and banquets, which are skipped

sources.name: erie-chamber
sources.itemPattern:
(?s)
Past Events)
sources.notes: Test data. WordPress (Divi with Divi Machine), no tribe route, no feed, no schema.org Event data. /events/ lists Upcoming Events cards (title, 'November 11, 2026', a one-line summary) and then Past Events. The itemPattern stops at the Past Events heading, because cards mode guesses the year and would put last year's past cards in the future. Cards link with data-link-url, not href, so each event links to the events page. No times

sources.name: estes-valley-library
sources.notes: Test data. LibCal ICS feed, in a town outside the covered cities. Closures and board meetings are skipped by title. fixedVenue, because the feed names rooms

sources.name: fiddlers-contest
sources.notes: Test data. The dates are in the home page banner ('Fiddlers' Contest & Festival', 'June 21st - 26th, 2027, Lyons, CO'), read as one all-day event. The datePattern's second branch borrows the first date's month, and both read the year from the banner, so after the contest the old dates are past rather than next year's. If the banner changes, the source finds 0 events

sources.name: little-gym-niwot
sources.notes: Test data. Kids' gym. The page lists 6 events server-side (Unleashed Brands calendar plugin, no feed, no schema.org events); a Load More button fetches the rest with JavaScript, which isn't read. Cards show the weekday and day, so the date comes from each card's booking link. No inferCategory, because themed titles mislead it ('Turkey Trot Parent Survival Night' read as a race)

sources.name: lyons-chamber
sources.notes: Test data. ChamberMaster (GrowthZone) calendar. The month page /events/calendar/YYYY-MM-01 links each event to /events/details/<slug>-<id>; each event's iCal file is /events/ical/<slug>-<id>.ics. Church services, meetings, closures, deadlines and the election are skipped by title

sources.name: museum-of-boulder
sources.notes: Test data. /event-listings has server-rendered event cards (month, day, title, time, link to /events/<slug>), no year and no schema.org data, so it needs a cards itemPattern with custom date, title, and time patterns

sources.name: nederland-winter-carnival
sources.notes: Test data. The page heading is 'Winter Carnival 2027' with the dates under it ('Jan 28', a dash, 'Feb 6'), read as one all-day event. yearFromTitle takes the year from the heading, so after the carnival the old page is read as past, not as next year. If the heading stops naming a year, or the page or its layout changes, the source finds 0 events

sources.name: recycled-minds
sources.notes: Test data. Improv comedy company at its own venue, The Creative Space. /shows is server-rendered, each show an h3 title, an h4 date line such as 'Saturday, Nov. 7th at 8PM' (no year), and a Get Tickets link to recycledmindsllc.thundertix.com/events/<id>

sources.name: shrine-social-club
sources.notes:
Test data. Music venue with two rooms (Ballroom and Basement). /shows/ is server-rendered, each a div.shr-show-item with a numeric date (Saturday
11/7/2026), doors time, headliner in div.fs-h1, the room, and a DICE ticket link. The doors time is written as 'Doors: 8pm' and the ticket links use single-quoted href; cards mode drops tags inside a time and reads either quote, and timePattern allows the tag

sources.name: superior-chamber
sources.excludeTitlePattern: (?i)\bmeeting\b|ribbon cutting|after hours|out to lunch|coffee klatch|\blions club\b|pre-order pickup
sources.notes: Test data. The events page embeds the whole ChamberMaster calendar as SvelteKit page data: an events list (Id, Name, StartTime, EndTime, IsAllDay, Slug) and eventDetails (EventName, EventLocation, Types). Chamber business (luncheons, After Hours, ribbon cuttings, Coffee Klatch, meetings, Lions Club) and pre-order pickups are skipped by title. Venues come from '(@ Superior Library)' or '@ Helina Marie's' in titles; the location field is nearly always empty

sources.name: town-of-superior
sources.notes: Test data. CivicPlus calendar: the list pages are allowed with a 10 second crawl delay, the iCalendar module and RSS.aspx are not. Meetings and closures are skipped by title

sources.name: visit-boulder
sources.notes: Test data. Modern Events Calendar. Its structured data has correct times with the -07:00 offset, so localTimeAsUtc is not set; the tests set it to check the correction against a page saved when the site wrote wall-clock time as UTC. Only the first page has structured data, about 12 events

sources.name: waneka-lake-park
sources.notes: Test data. Squarespace. robots.txt disallows format=ical and format=json, so this reads each event page
